data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出RTT/RTMA递归自改进，把适应方法本身作为改进对象；独立准入的继任者承担下一代角色，并有反馈实验。

scope_support.feedback_quote: In four-candidate program selection, retaining LARC feedback updates reduces expected error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points for two trained initializations.
scope_support.object_quote: A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor.
scope_support.persistence_quote: An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation.
